title: Release manifest (.foundry/releases/<id>/release.yaml)
description: DOCUMENTATION of the shape `scripts/foundry_release.py`'s own `_validate()` enforces at load time -- that Python function, not this file, is the ENFORCED floor (the module's own docstring: 'there is NO floor-gate field -- the floor is core-owned'); this schema is not loaded/validated-against by any script, mirroring how the release manifest has always been hand-validated in Python rather than jsonschema-driven. Kept in sync with `_TOP_REQUIRED_FIELDS`/`_TOP_OPTIONAL_FIELDS`/`_ATOM_FIELDS`/`_ATOM_OPTIONAL_FIELDS` by convention, for a human or an LLM authoring a manifest by hand.

id.description: The release's slug; must match its directory name under .foundry/releases/.

state.description: The RA/RD state machine's forward-only state. `proposed` reads as a synonym of `planned` on load; a subsequent write always persists the real four-value vocabulary.

integration_branch.description: (branch-and-worktree-discipline, AC-BWD-4, v1.16.0) The release's integration branch, e.g. 'release/1.16.0' -- created from `main` as `/foundry:intake`'s LAST step. Purely descriptive: never read by the RA/RD state machine or `derive_closure`. Consumed by `/foundry:merge-when-green` (the base-branch refusal) and `skills/cut-release/SKILL.md` (the R -> R2 -> tag flow).

acceptance.description: The optional PRACTICE acceptance log (date, operator, verdict, note) -- never a gate.

spec_ref.description: Factory-lane atom (paired with contract_ref); EXCLUSIVE of charter_ref.

charter_ref.description: Charter-lane atom (release-loader-vocabulary, AC-RLV-2); EXCLUSIVE of spec_ref/contract_ref.

kind.description: Free-text atom kind (e.g. NS, HC); never gated.
